map.输入工件厚度、宽度、榫厚比例与榫头类型，按木工标准比例（榫厚≈1/3 厚度、榫长: Enter the stock thickness, width, tenon-thickness ratio and tenon type to compute each dimension and the mortise depth by woodworking standard ratios (tenon ≈ 1/3 thickness, tenon length ≈ 1.5× thickness).
map.家具框架榫接合设计：桌柜框架的方材接合，按工件厚度 quick 定榫厚、榫长与榫: Furniture frame tenon-joint design: for square-stock joints in table/cabinet frames, set the tenon thickness, length and mortise depth by stock thickness to ensure strength without splitting the mortise.
map.门窗框、柜体结构制作：批量下料前算好每枚榫的宽与肩，避免榫眼过深接近贯穿。: Door/window frames and cabinet structure: compute each tenon width and shoulder before batch cutting to avoid mortises that are too deep and nearly through.
map.木工教学与下料参考：把经验比例（榫厚≈1/3 厚、榫长≈1.5×厚）固化成可复算: Woodworking teaching and stock reference: turn the empirical ratios (tenon ≈ 1/3 thickness, length ≈ 1.5× thickness) into a recomputable checklist for training and material prep.
map.暗榫示例（工件厚 30mm / 宽 80mm / 比例 1:3 / 接合件厚 6: Blind tenon example (stock 30mm / width 80mm / ratio 1:3 / mating piece 60mm / end shoulder 6mm)
map.榫厚 tt = 0.333 × 30 = 9.99 mm（卡片显示 10.0）；: Tenon thickness tt = 0.333 × 30 = 9.99 mm (card shows 10.0); single-side shoulder in thickness = (30 − 9.99)/2 = 10.00 mm; tenon length tl = 1.5 × 30 = 45.00 mm (card 45.0); blind-mortise depth md = 45 + 2 = 47.00 mm, bottom thickness = 60 − 47 = 13.00 mm (≥6mm, no warning); tenon width tw = 80 − 2×6 = 68.00 mm; single-cheek glue area = 45×68 = 3060 mm² = 30.60 cm², both-cheek total glue area = 61.20 cm², strength adequate.
map.榫厚为什么取 1/3 工件厚度？: Why set tenon thickness to 1/3 of stock thickness?
map.经验上榫厚取工件厚度的 1/3（硬木）到 3/8（软木）能在不削弱工件的前提下获: Empirically tenon thickness is 1/3 (hardwood) to 3/8 (softwood) of stock thickness, giving enough glue area without weakening the stock; too thick splits the mortise, too thin lacks shear strength. The calculator outputs tenon thickness and single-side shoulder directly from the chosen ratio for easy checking.
map.榫眼深为何要留 ≥6mm 底厚？: Why keep ≥6mm bottom thickness in the mortise?
map.暗榫榫眼深 = 榫长 + 2mm 装配间隙，若底厚（接合件厚 − 榫眼深）小于约: Blind-mortise depth = tenon length + 2mm assembly clearance; if the bottom thickness (mating-piece thickness − mortise depth) is under about 6mm, drilling or chiseling risks reaching through and the joint splits easily under load. The calculator warns when bottom thickness is insufficient, suggesting a shorter tenon or thicker mating piece.
map.榫厚 = 比例 × 工件厚度 T；单边榫肩 = (T − 榫厚) ÷ 2: Tenon thickness = ratio × workpiece thickness T; shoulder per side = (T − tenon thickness) ÷ 2
map.榫长 = 1.5 × T；贯通榫需 ≥ 接合件厚度，默认穿出 3 mm: Tenon length = 1.5 × T; a through tenon must be ≥ the mating part thickness, protruding 3 mm by default
map.榫宽 = 工件宽 − 2 × 端部榫肩；双榫再均分并扣除中间榫肩(≈榫厚): Tenon width = workpiece width − 2 × end shoulder; for a double tenon, split evenly and deduct the middle shoulder (≈ tenon thickness)
map.榫眼深：暗榫/带肩 = 榫长 + 2 mm 间隙；贯通 = 接合件厚度: Mortise depth: blind/shouldered = tenon length + 2 mm clearance; through = mating part thickness
map.防扭榫肩高/长 ≈ 榫厚（带肩榫专用）: Anti-rotation tenon shoulder height/length ≈ tenon thickness (for shouldered tenons)
map.胶接面积：单面单枚 = 榫长 × 榫宽；总胶接面 = 枚数 × 2 面: Glue area: one face of one tenon = tenon length × tenon width; total glue area = tenon count × 2 faces
map.工艺红线：榫眼底厚 ≥6 mm；单枚榫宽 > 榫厚；榫宽 > 0: Hard limits: mortise bottom thickness ≥6 mm; tenon width per piece > tenon thickness; tenon width > 0
map.端部榫肩不能为负：负肩会把榫宽算得比工件还大。请调整端肩或工件宽度。: End shoulders cannot be negative: a negative shoulder makes the tenon wider than the workpiece. Adjust the shoulder or workpiece width.
map.榫厚比例必须在 0–1 之间（常用 1/3）；超出范围榫厚/肩宽无几何意义。: Tenon thickness ratio must be between 0 and 1 (typically 1/3); outside that range the thickness/shoulder geometry is meaningless.
map.端肩合计过大，榫宽 ≤ 0，无法形成榫颊与胶接面；请减小端肩或加大工件宽度。: The combined end shoulders are too large, giving a tenon width ≤ 0 and no cheek or glue surface; reduce the shoulders or widen the workpiece.
